outcome.success: Mission completed: the judge confirmed it.
outcome.interrupted: Mission stopped by the user. This is not a success.
outcome.failure: Mission failed. No success is counted.

form.missionPlaceholder: Collect as many samples as possible and return to base
form.unsupported: The environment does not support this
form.seedInvalid: Seed must be a whole number

start.offline: No live connection to the server
start.commandBusy: A command is already in flight

stop.offline: No live connection to the server
stop.commandBusy: A command is already in flight

splash.title: The explorer is ready
splash.description: Pick a profile and press Start. The map, plan and journal will appear here.
splash.offlineDescription: The panel keeps trying to connect.
splash.startingRos: Waiting for ROS. Start becomes available once the environment is ready.
splash.startingEnv: ROS is connected, the environment is finishing its start-up.
splash.readyFallback: The LLM is unavailable, so the fallback algorithm will plan. Pick a profile and press Start.
splash.rejectedDescription: The server did not accept the command. The reason is in the mission card.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.retryable: The error is retryable: start a new run.
summary.final: Retrying will not help: the environment needs a fix.

teamOutcome.success: The team completed the mission: the judge confirmed it.
teamOutcome.partial: Partial team success: not every robot finished the mission.
teamOutcome.failed: The team failed. No success is counted.
teamOutcome.stopped: The team was stopped by the user. This is not a successful finish.

navigation.hint: Enter X and Y or select a point on the map. Motion starts only after you press Start.
navigation.profile: Navigation: easy / static map / one robot.
navigation.unsupported: The environment does not advertise easy/static/1 navigation.
navigation.locked: The target is locked until the run finishes or stops.

problem.empty: Enter X and Y or select a point on the map.
problem.invalid_number: X and Y must be finite coordinates in meters.
problem.no_map: Wait for the map to load.
problem.map_mismatch: The panel map differs from the robot map. Wait for an update.
problem.outside_map: Select a point within the map.
problem.map_changed: The map or connection changed. Confirm the point again.

warning.occupied: The cell is occupied; the executor may reject the target.
warning.unknown: The cell is unknown; the executor will check reachability.

outcome.success: Target reached, robot returned; the judge confirmed completion.
outcome.unconfirmed: Run ended without confirmed target arrival. Navigation was not successful.
outcome.stopped: Stopped by user. The full mission was not completed.
outcome.failed: Mission failed. See the run result for the cause.
outcome.not_reached: Target not reached. See the journal for the return or stop reason; success is not counted.
outcome.return_failed: Target reached, but return or completion is not confirmed.
outcome.returning: Target reached. Success requires return to base and confirmed finish.
